summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long CRML Daily ETF (CRMX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in materials equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Critical Metals Corp. (CRML) CRMX was launched on Jan 12, 2026 and is issued by Tradr.
